description: Place a stretch of music on a part: a notes region (empty for score.add_notes, or with notes passed now) or an audio region (media, or a source range of it: a loop, a recording, a stem). at_beats and length_beats place it (or at_seconds and length_seconds). Audio keeps its own speed unless fit_beats is given, which stretches it to that many beats without changing its pitch. Regions on one part may overlap and sound together. Returns the new score_id (edit that one next), the region_id, and where it sits in beats, seconds and frames.

at_beats.description: Where it starts. One of at_beats or at_seconds

fit_beats.description: Stretch the audio to this many beats, pitch unchanged

gain_db.description: Level of an audio region. Default 0

length_beats.description: Its length (or length_seconds). Required for a notes region; default for audio is the source's length

media_id.description: Audio media, for an audio region

notes.description: Notes to put in it now, as in score.add_notes

at_beats.description: Start, in beats from the region's start

at_seconds.description: Start, in seconds from the region's start

pitch.description: A MIDI number 0–127, decimals allowed (60.5 a quarter-tone above middle C), or a name such as C3 or F#4; C4 is 60, middle C

velocity.description: 1 to 127: how hard it is struck

source.description: {from_seconds, until_seconds} of the media. Default all of it
